english.title: Driver of vehicle fail to take at least 24 consec hours weekly reduced rest period - taken other than where based - AETR
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to take a reduced weekly rest period of at least twenty four consecutive hours after six daily driving periods ending at **(..SPECIFY DATE AND TIME..), at a place other than the place where the vehicle or the driver was usually based, in contravention of Article 8.3 of the European Agreement Concerning the Work of Crews of Vehicles Engaged in International Road Transport
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) See article 6.1 for meaning of 'daily driving period' and article 8.3 for definition of 'weekly rest period' and circumstances in which the weekly rest period may be reduced.
(ii) Where the place of offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
